bench.title: Browser Benchmark
bench.description: Balanced Merman and Mermaid measurements in isolated browser runtimes. Fresh runtime samples may reuse the HTTP cache; cache observations are reported separately.
bench.realmColdDescription: Each measured sample rebuilds a separate iframe and module state. The primary result uses one parent clock from sample dispatch through strict SVG validation; bootstrap and HTTP cache observations remain separate.
bench.warmDescription: Each engine keeps its own isolated iframe, receives the same number of real-source warmups, then is measured repeatedly to the same strict parent-side SVG boundary.
bench.cancelledShowingPrevious: The latest run was cancelled. Showing the previous result.
bench.staleDescription: This run keeps its frozen source and options. Current editor changes will render after the benchmark releases the live coordinator.
bench.preparing: Pausing live rendering and preparing isolated runtimes
bench.setupEvidenceDescription: Parent-clock artifact acquisition and isolated-runtime bootstrap finish before the isolated-runtime sample clock. They are retained separately and are not presented as network-cold evidence.
bench.rawEvidenceDescription: Failed and warmup samples remain inspectable here and in the downloaded report; they never enter measured aggregates.
bench.noSamples: No sample completed before the terminal event.
bench.failureEvidenceDescription: Each failure remains attributed to the engine and stage that produced it.

metricDescriptions.firstPublishableSvgMs: One parent clock from dispatch to a fresh isolated runtime through response-envelope checks and the same strict SVG projector used by the Playground.
metricDescriptions.warmPublishableSvgMs: One parent clock from dispatch to a reused isolated runtime through response-envelope checks and the same strict SVG projector used by the Playground.

themes.nightfall: Quiet slate, soft color and clear labels for dark canvases.
themes.letterpress: Warm paper, serif titles and rust accents for editorial diagrams.
themes.grove: Ivory, moss green and mineral colors for a warmer view.
themes.riso: A small-run print in blue and red: slight registration offsets, crisp single-pass text, and editorial titles.

projectUse.description: Copy integration code and download the files needed to use this diagram or theme.

projectUse.scopeDescription_diagram: Use the completed render's configured source, binding options, layout and versions. Host fonts and measurement still matter.

projectUse.snapshotFixed: These materials stay fixed while this dialog is open.
projectUse.workspaceChanged: The workspace has changed. These files still describe the captured snapshot; capture again to use the new state.
projectUse.chooseScope: Choose a scope with available materials to download.
projectUse.action_copied: File copied. Download the ZIP for its companion files.
projectUse.action_failed: Could not copy or download. Try the action again.
projectUse.setup_rust: Extract beside a matching merman source checkout, adjust Cargo.toml's local path if needed, then run cargo run. The example uses this repository's Renderer API.
projectUse.setup_cli: Use merman-cli built from the matching checkout with native-fonts (included by default). Mathematical labels also require math. Run python render.py --cli /path/to/merman-cli or copy render-command.txt. Measurement is deterministic with system fonts off.
projectUse.setup_web: Use the matching local Web package, glue and WASM. Adjust package.json's file dependency, prepare that checkout's Web artifacts, then npm install and npm run dev. This does not assume a published npm version.
projectUse.configProvenance: diagram.mmd already contains the authored config as a source init directive. source.mmd and playground-config.json are originals for reference. Only the frozen host initialization goes into site-config.json / CLI --config-file; do not inject the editor config twice.
projectUse.notice_fonts: Font names do not include font files. Supply and load the same host fonts. Measurement and font rendering can change geometry; cross-host pixel equivalence is not promised.
projectUse.notice_native-measurement: This snapshot used browser measurement. Rust and CLI use deterministic measurement here; the source and presentation inputs are retained with that explicit host difference.
projectUse.notice_cli-screen-width: CLI has no screen-available-width flag and falls back to container width for C4. The captured screen width remains in options.json and handoff.json for Rust/Web.
projectUse.notice_local-source: The Playground checkout identity records source provenance, not a WASM or binary hash. A dirty checkout includes uncommitted changes. Matching artifacts still require compatible versions and facade/glue/WASM from the same revision; package version alone does not pin a runtime or preset catalog.
projectUse.error_render-not-current: There is no completed successful Merman render matching this snapshot. Wait for the current render, then capture again, or choose Theme only.
projectUse.error_invalid-configuration: The captured configuration or theme recipe cannot form a valid request. Fix the workspace inputs and capture again.
projectUse.error_preset-unavailable: Preset “{{id}}” is not confirmed available. The preview may have fallen back. Choose an available builtin preset or import a standalone recipe before generating project code.
projectUse.error_no-theme: No Merman theme or explicit Mermaid base is selected. Choose a theme, or use Reproduce current diagram to take the configured diagram.
projectUse.error_theme-conflict: Both a preset and a custom recipe are selected. Choose one theme source and capture again.
projectUse.error_recipe-unverified: This recipe has not been validated by the current runtime. Wait for the renderer, then capture again.

tools.compareStyled: Both panes use the same Mermaid source and configuration. Merman appearance extensions apply only to the left pane. This styled comparison does not certify pixel parity.

export.resvgBoundary: The resvg-compatible pipeline adapts SVG for resvg/usvg. It does not establish portability to every host.

output.title: Output compatibility

status.portable: The runtime’s target checks passed for this SVG and these inputs. Compatibility with every host is not established.
status.host_dependent: This SVG depends on the host’s fonts, text measurement or rendering.
status.rejected: The runtime’s output compatibility checks failed, although an SVG was returned. Review its evidence before use.
status.unverified: The runtime did not verify compatibility for this SVG’s target.
status.unknown: No recognized runtime compatibility evidence is available for this SVG.

output.unknownStatus: The runtime reported an unrecognized target status: {{status}}. Compatibility remains unknown.
output.mermanRaster: These checks describe the frozen source SVG. The raster image is prepared from the same snapshot using resvg-compatible SVG; source checks do not verify that conversion.
output.mermaidRaster: These checks describe the frozen source SVG, which is rasterized for this image. They do not verify raster conversion.

reasons.theme_evidence_incomplete: Theme execution evidence is incomplete for these target checks.
reasons.svg_terminal_unverified: The final SVG has not been verified for the requested target.
reasons.svg_terminal_validation_failed: The final SVG did not pass target validation.
reasons.host_dependent_text_layout: Text layout depends on the host’s measurement or rendering.
reasons.svg_fonts_not_self_contained: The SVG does not contain all required fonts; the host may supply them.
reasons.font_resolution_incomplete: Some requested fonts could not be resolved.
reasons.system_or_host_font_dependency: The output depends on fonts supplied by the system or host.
